dialogues.en:
<$iicon(2533)><$cdef(27)>wildflowers.
A faint, sweet aroma wafts about it.

It looks like construction is underway. Some
strong Pokémon might show up to help!

Pokémon who like to train may come here to sit under
the waterfall and tone their bodies.

A comfy birdhouse with a neatly trimmed
hedge. You can almost hear chirping...

Stop your bicycle here for a quick break. Pokémon
sometimes hide behind the vending machine!

Light the candle to read by firelight!
This place feels spooky when night falls.

Enjoy teatime while admiring the potted tree.
Pokémon can feel refreshed here.

Beautifully blooming flowers beneath the shade of
a tree. Pokémon are attracted by the damp scent.

A large field of flowers. Every petal emanates an
ambrosial aroma.

Trash cans put in place to prevent littering.
You can sometimes find Pokémon inside them.

When you fuel this amazing contraption,
it generates electricity with the power of fire.

The colorful neon lights of this festival entrance
glow brilliantly, especially at night.

Absolutely no crossing while the bar is lowered!
But...will Pokémon actually stop and wait?

Give your look a once-over in the mirror after you
change clothes. A place to become your ideal self!

Put a register on a table, power it on, and boom!
You’ll be ready for business in no time!

Even a simple locker room can have a refreshing
atmosphere with the addition of a houseplant or two.

Wash your dishes and ingredients, then cook away
on the stove. What’s on the menu for today?

Anything can look like a masterpiece
if you pop it on an exhibition stand!

Growing in the shade of a tree, this pink
grass is just the tiniest bit damp.

It may look like a bunch of junk, but every single
piece here is worthy of study to a professor!

The warm air from three campfires
rises high into the sky!

With a stove, a sink, and some key cooking
equipment, this place is a chef’s dream.

Tall grass along the water’s edge. A habitat thriving
with energy, thanks to an abundance of water.

This stage was made for just one thing—
now get up there and SING!

A small plot made up of four tufts of yellow tall grass.
Spots like this are often found in harbor towns.

A concrete pipe that hasn’t been used in a long time.
The hollow interior is perfect for a secret base!

A gently lit plot of tall grass.
Pokémon are drawn to the inviting light.

Looks like someone snuck a snack by some storage
containers. Pokémon might like a spot like this.

Yellow tall grass in the shade of a tree.
The habitat has a melancholy feel to it.

Pokémon can also soak in a nice hot spring
while enjoying beautiful scenery!

Some Pokémon enjoy moving between the hot spring
and the cold bath to feel light and refreshed!

The elegant aroma of these <$iicon(2559)><$cdef(27)>mountain flowers
wafts all throughout the area.

These elegant <$iicon(2559)><$cdef(27)>mountain flowers bloom
beautifully, even right beside the water.

Tall grass that stands firm against the spray of
saltwater. Good for escaping the seaside heat.

Red tall grass flourishes even in
high-altitude areas like mountaintops.
A cute field full of lots of puffy <$iicon(765)><$cdef(27)>skyland flowers</color>.

Poofy <$iicon(765)><$cdef(27)>skyland flowers bloom cutely—
even in the cool shade of a tree.

Water can’t diminish the gentle aroma
wafting from these <$iicon(765)><$cdef(27)>skyland flowers.

A trash can beside a vending machine.
Doesn’t look like there are any empty cans inside...

<$iicon(1214)><$cdef(27)>Seashore flowers rest beneath the leaves of a
palm tree. Their tropical aroma drifts around the area.

Some Pokémon might mistake all
these dolls for the real things!

Just sitting at this desk with a pencil in hand
is enough to make you feel a little smarter.

Packed with old documents and unused equipment.
Lost Pokémon sometimes wander inside.

An ordinary bathroom. Pokémon might
stop by to wash themselves.

Sit on the office chair and type away at the computer.
If you feel tired, grab a beverage and take a break!

Making sure your skin is moisturized will ensure your
makeup comes out even more perfectly than usual!

Some big speakers and a TV make this
space feel just like a movie theater.

If you’re feeling chilly, you can sit by this
fireplace, and it will gently warm you.

Washing your face and drying it off with a towel feels
refreshing. Check out how you look in the mirror!

Pokémon might come here mistakenly thinking
that this is an actual sleeping Snorlax!

Players sit side by side here to game against
each other! Pokémon might come here to play.

A comfy couch in front of an organization’s emblem.
Sitting here makes you feel like a boss.

The large machine doesn’t seem to work,
even if you plug in the cords and hit the buttons...

A strange, smooth rock has drained
the vitality from this tall grass.

Cast a line and wait patiently. Perhaps a
Water-type Pokémon will appear!

Ocean fishing can be fun! You may meet different
species of Pokémon than you would in fresh water.

Pokémon live in marshlands too! Try casting
your line into some swampy water sometime.

Pokémon enjoying a nice dip in the hot spring might
be lured in with some bait.

Catch Pokémon by fishing in magma.
Wait, how do you do that without the line melting?!

Putting an offering of food on this platter would
surely delight Pokémon who love to eat.

A pop-art box surrounded by balloons.
What’s in the box? Open it and find out!

A photoworthy bronze statue of three Pokémon.
Their combined cuteness is sure to attract a crowd!

There’s no better thrill than lifting the
lid off a dish to reveal today’s meal!

The partition helps keep prying eyes
away before you’re ready for the public.

You and Arcanine, interrogating perps side by side...
The tension in the air is palpable.

Such a high elevation means this area is quite cool.
The wind blows all the way through the tall grass.

A display of an ancient Pokémon fossil. It features
a hard neck frill that looks like a shield.

A display of ancient Pokémon fossils. This specimen’s
large neck frill was as sturdy as a fortress wall.

A display of an ancient Pokémon fossil.
This fossilized skull is as hard as iron.

A display of ancient Pokémon fossils.
This specimen’s skull was harder than steel.

A display of an ancient Pokémon fossil. It features a
piece of a jawbone that could crush anything.

A display of ancient Pokémon fossils. This fine
skeletal specimen was once the ruler of the land.

A display of an ancient Pokémon fossil.
This piece of a neck sail was once frozen in ice.

A display of ancient Pokémon fossils. The specimen’s
beautiful neck sail resembles an aurora.

A display of ancient Pokémon fossils. This fine
skeletal specimen was once the ruler of the skies.

A lone TV left out with the garbage. It looks like it
can still be turned on.

Wheel out the dishes nice and slow, because once
they reach the table, it’s chow time!

A peaceful, refreshing spot to take a break
while Chansey watches over you.

Help yourself to food and drinks, and have
a total blast with all your friends!

Maybe using psychic power to peer into the crystal
ball will give you a glimpse of the future...

Reading feels even more relaxing when
you throw on some background music.

A map and compass are essential treasure-hunting
tools. Time to set off in search of jewels!

Prepare some side dishes while you
wait for bread to finish baking.

The sofa and doll are both Pikachu! Some Pokémon
might mistake them for the real Pikachu and stop by.

Bird Pokémon may swoop in and use the
microphone to show off their singing skills.

The gentle sway of these nine blazing flames gives
their surroundings a subtly mystical ambience.

Being surrounded by all this cute furniture
will make you feel perfectly pampered.

A large TV with a rhythm game hooked up to it.
Step on the mats in time with the beat!

Put lots of cleaner on the Mareep sponge
and make that bathroom shine!

When you’re done playing arcade games, you can hit
up the punching game to get your body moving!

To play on the big slide or with the toys...
Now that’s a hard choice!

Light the lamp to peruse the books at
your leisure, even in the dark of night.

Take a breather in a garden chair
while looking at softly lit flowers.

Kick back by a palm tree and feel the ocean
breeze for the full tropical experience.

Pokémon can feel the rhythm here and
get pumped up for a training session.

A space for conducting experiments.
Someone may have left their research notes behind!

A dumping ground where you can even throw away
large items. Unwanted appliances can go here!

A bed of refreshing <$iicon(1214)><$cdef(27)>seashore flowers. Pokémon
are drawn in by its gentle scent.

A berry table, a berry bed... Everything’s a berry!
Just looking at them makes you hungry.

Every single piece of this furniture set is top-notch,
creating the ultimate air of luxury.

Tall grass near a large boulder.
Perfect for hide-and-seek.

After a fierce training session, Pokémon can
rest their tired bodies on this bench.

A space perfectly tailored for gaming. Take a seat
and immerse yourself in the world of games!

The wail of the guitar marks the start
of this amped-up performance!

The hum of the bass guitar marks the start
of a low-key musical performance.

Yellow tall grass by the water. A nice resting spot
for Pokémon after they’re done swimming.

Haul logs with the cart and split them on the tree
stump. The chair is there for taking breaks.

Light the candles by the gravestone to add some
swaying blue flames for double the eeriness.

Tall grass growing in a marsh. Pokémon use
this to wipe mud off themselves.

A conspicuous button next to a boo-in-the-box.
To press, or not to press, that is the question.

A slightly eerie space where a mysterious
ritual appears to be underway...

A slightly mystical space where a mysterious
ritual appears to be underway...

A table set with dishes—and a chair for sitting.
Hungry Pokémon might swing by here.

A basket placed atop a table is all
it takes to feel a little picnicky.

The large ribbon and heart decorations make this
cake look quite lovely. It tastes incredibly sweet.

Shaved ice served with frozen toppings. Eating this
could make you feel teeth-chatteringly chilly.

A sandwich packed with greens and veggies
would really hit the spot right now.

A small plot made up of four tufts of red tall grass.
Spots like this are often found in valleys.

Pokémon are drawn to this place, invited by
the damp aroma of the red tall grass.

Nothing like a good nap when you’re feeling sick.
A caring Pokémon might even come to check in!

The bags of dirt can be used as dumbbells.
Perfect for Pokémon who love to train!

A hot spring surrounded by green moss. Soak up the
calming atmosphere as you soak in warm water.

Pokémon will be fascinated by the fluffy yarn and
the adorable crafts that can be made from it.

Lean against this rock in the tall grass, and take
a break while admiring the large pointy tree.

A lone vending machine amid yellow tall grass.
Gotta stay hydrated—even out in nature!

A small plot made up of four tufts of pink tall grass.
Spots like this are often found in the skylands.

You can walk on top of the duckweed or
jump into the water and float next to them!

Putting hot sauce on this round pizza will make it so
spicy that you’ll feel like you’re breathing fire!

A basket of crispy fried potato stars.
They’re shockingly delicious!

A clear-blue ice-cream float. It’s like looking deep
into the ocean.

Today’s research topic is Pokémon’s role in science!
Some data has been entered into the computer.

Reminders of rain and a plate for offering food.
This is the perfect spot to call for rainy weather.

Sitting by a campfire underneath a palm tree...
Let’s kick back and cook some food!

The pink of the tall grass contrasts beautifully
with the blue hues of the water.

Reminders of sunshine and a plate for offering food.
This is the perfect spot to call for fair weather.

Pokémon may be lured here by the glow of the
mushroom and the scent of the plant-shaped pot.

You can’t jump in the hot spring without rinsing off at
a shower first! Pokémon might enjoy soaking here.

Stand in front of the wheel or right by the cannons,
and you’ll feel like you’re sailing the open seas!

Once you embody the spirit of the warrior, you will
be able to move even the heaviest of boulders.

Have fun on the inflatable boat! If you get
tired, you can take a break under the umbrella.

Numerous <$iicon(2559)><$cdef(27)>mountain flowers bloom to
form an elegant and beautiful flower bed.

Take a seat in front of the canvas and let your
imagination run wild. Inspiration is waiting to strike!

Bird Pokémon can lounge in the birdhouse
after enjoying a meal of various berries.

A field of blooming waterside flowers. Pokémon
may be attracted by the aroma and clear water.

A bed of flowers blooming at high elevation.
The wind carries their sweet aroma all around.

Sit in front of the crystal ball and focus to gain
mastery over your psychic powers...maybe.

A habitat that exudes a gentle elegance.
Pokémon could rest in joyful peace here.

Plant some hedges near blooming flowers,
and you’ll have a decent garden in no time flat.

A bed with a cute doll. Small Pokémon
would probably feel safe sleeping here.

A flower vase placed on top of a table. Pokémon
might sit on the chair to look at the flower.

Candles and plated food placed silently
before a gravestone. Pretty creepy...

A bench near some hedges. Pokémon can
rest here and bask in nature.

A bed bathed in gentle light. Pokémon could
probably sleep peacefully here.

A first-aid kit is on hand in case any
Pokémon injure themselves exercising.

A campsite that celebrates elements of nature.
Pokémon warm themselves in front of the campfire.
This long, wide cart can fit two large crates.

A solitary sign by the middle of the road.
Pokémon might head in the arrow’s direction.

The rhythm of the big drum, the spotlights on
the boo-in-the-box... The suspense is palpable!

A bench illuminated by gentle light.
Pokémon entranced by the light might stop by.

Yellow tall grass growing at high elevation.
It sways back and forth in the sea breeze.

Dishes on a table. There’s even a menu,
so it’s just like being in a restaurant.

Lounge under this parasol, and bask in the tropical
vibes. Pokémon might enjoy relaxing here.

Let’s pack some cardboard boxes full of
stuff and stack them on top of a cart!

A long bench beside a vending machine.
Pokémon might swing by to take a breather.

Kick back with a drink in your hand and use
the tablet to reminisce over some photos.

A stage bathed in dazzling light. It seems
likely to attract attention-seeking Pokémon.

This amazing facility generates electricity
through the power of a waterfall!

After eating a snack, put your trash in the trash can.
...Think Pokémon can remember to do that?

A breeze whooshes over this cool flower bed. As the
windmill turns, a floral aroma spreads far and wide.

Lunch box? Check. Tableware? Check.
Time for a picnic lunch break!

Scattered toys and cardboard. Just when you think
you’re done tidying up, the mess somehow returns.

Empty cardboard boxes and a fluffy straw bed.
Opinions are divided on which provides better sleep.

Construction needs a lot of electricity!
You can use any leftover lumber as fuel.

Bird Pokémon are sure to come and
enjoy feasting on the plated food.

A cozy little dock on the beach.
Swimming Pokémon might stop by now and then.

Keep up with your research, and someday you might
become as wise and learned as Professor Tangrowth!

The leaves of a palm tree serve as a parasol
to Pokémon resting in the beach chair.

Some trash left by a power pole.
Its surroundings smell a little stinky.

A place to dump everyone’s garbage. You might
even spot some trash-hunting Pokémon here!

When injured, seek first aid immediately!
Pokémon skilled at healing may come to this habitat.

Pack a lunch box and canteen inside your
backpack, and you’re all set for a field trip!

Anyone can freely pick up and enjoy the
newspapers and magazines found here.

Say cheese! Stick your face in the cutout board
and snap a photo to commemorate your hike.

A cozy campfire underneath a clear sky.
Prepare a big feast and have a good time!

While red tall grass often grows in valleys,
it also thrives just fine on the waterside.

This space is packed with wooden furniture.
It feels almost like you’re in a mountain cabin!

Enjoy the retro vibe of this collection
of wonderful antique furniture!

Just power up the cash register, and you’ll be able
to trade with your friends—even out in nature!

All Poké Balls...or so you thought!
Living here is oddly comforting somehow.

Relax on the sofa or lie down on the hammock,
and you’ll feel like you’re in the lap of luxury.

The colorful pop-art furniture gives off a cheerful
atmosphere that’ll lift your spirits in no time!

A monochromatic space with weighty furniture.
Light the lantern to add another layer of calm.

A quiet, peaceful atmosphere. It looks
like Pokémon could really unwind here.

A simple yet calming space.
Pokémon are sure to be comfortable here.

Stylishly simple. The modern design
gives off a sense of classiness.

Cookies made from dark chocolate. They have a
subtle, comforting taste without being overly sweet.

Teatime is always midday. Take a seat, have a snack,
and bask in the elegance of it all.

Nothin’ but piping-hot lava here!
Fire-type Pokémon simply can’t resist visiting.

A big furnace with equipment next to it.
Someone might come to light the flame!

Board the canoe, or just enjoy some
tranquil time relaxing by the waterside.

Vegetables growing in a nice, wide field. Seems
likely to attract Pokémon who enjoy farming.

For some reason, the tires are more enticing than the
big slide... Yeah! Let’s play with all the different tires!

A field of warm, blooming yellow flowers.
Just looking at it seems to fill you with energy.

Use the torches to light a path to the waterfall.
Pokémon might stop by to check it out.

Surrounded by shining stars and fluffy clouds,
you’ll feel like you’re living in a dream.

Setting the bedside alarm clock makes
waking up in the morning a breeze.

Tall grass that can be seen all over the sea floor.
Marine Pokémon may come here to hide.

Bushy tall grass and a variety of corals make
this a perfect resting spot for Pokémon.

A cluster of small flowers and luxuriant
leaves that sways gently to and fro.

This gorgeous tableau of colorful corals
and basin flowers can lift your mood.

Flowers and seaweed sway gently
beside rugged chimney rocks.

Dig around the chimney rocks to
see if you can find any treasure!

The fluffy pink moss makes this spot
very popular with aquatic Pokémon.

Creepy chimney rocks surrounded by sea moss.
Pick up the lantern and take a closer look.

A bunch of seaweed near some netting.
Somehow none of it gets tangled in the mesh.

Both the basin tall grass and the pile
of sand are hiding spots for Pokémon.

Get your rake and shovel, then start
digging until you find what you’re after!

Pokémon curious about the platform
may pop out of the sandpile.

A punching bag hanging near a set of dentures.
Pokémon with big jaws may be tempted to take a bite.

A treasure chest that’s been tossed out with
the trash. Open it up and see what’s inside!

Turn the ship’s wheel next to the treasure chest,
just like a sea captain! Steady as she goes!

Take the jewels out of the chest and
illuminate them with the lantern.

Sparkling jewelry and a bottled ship.
These should be stored very carefully.

Colorful corals of various sizes. Pokémon who
are coral connoisseurs find them irresistible.

Sit on the cushion beside the coral
and relax while gazing at the light.

Just power up the cash register, and you’ll be
ready for business in no time—even underwater!

Grab some berries and a blender, and
you’ll be all set to make smoothies.

The huge cushion bed and fluffy doll
create a soothing environment.

A cozy little canoe dock. Pokémon
may come by to ride the canoe.

Have fun in the muddy water by playing
with the toys or riding the floating logs.

A luxurious spa with a large, prominent fountain.
Taking a mud bath may turn your skin silky smooth!

A row of lampions hanging upside down, but
that’s fine as long as they shine brightly.

Relax and enjoy teatime in a chic space
while admiring a bottled ship.
Fill the tub and enjoy a fun, bubbly bath time.
Dance on a stage bursting with bubbles!

A shiny stage perfect for a trio.
Gather everyone and get singing!

A harp that gleams in the lamplight.
Try strumming a melody inspired by the ocean.

An elegant space adorned with shell and pearl
furniture. You could probably get extra stylish here.

Sleeping surrounded by gorgeously decorated
furniture may help you drift into fancy dreams.

This space with a shining pearl sofa
feels ready for someone to arrive.

Listen to the melody of the music box
and take a stroll down memory lane.

Even the heat of the molten rock could
not stop the thick growth of moss.

Relax in the cute sand bed or
play with the huge swim ring.

Enjoy the beach to the fullest by playing
volleyball or relaxing on the swim ring.

Trickster ghosts have been
eyeing these delicious sweets.
Pokémon may be drawn here by the mysterious light.

Many Syrupy Apples have been harvested here.
The air is thick with their sweet scent.

A perfectly baked apple pie.
Sweet juice oozes out with every bite.

A kitchen full of apple-themed equipment. It makes
you want to cook up some delicious sweets.
